decisions.decision:
Clone Usetantra/tantra-frontend-v2 -b adi-new-ui, check all 9 items in code, then apply these decisions on a new branch, pricing-lineup-2026-10:
(1) Take SMS out of ENTERPRISE_CALL_DESCRIPTION.
(2) Rewrite the Enterprise card and FAQ as coaching plus a done-with-you build, $9,999, 1 year of platform access.
(3) Keep the name 'Scale' for the $199 plan.
(4) Take Telegram off /pricing.
(5) Change every 'Start Free' to START_CTA_LABEL, 'Start free trial'.
(6) Rewrite the ~10 add-on help articles and the ToS/Privacy add-on lines to match the plan line-up (no add-ons; $20 per extra account).
(7) Change /billing to the plan model. Write the Dodo product spec (Scale $199/mo, $20 extra account) to docs/.
(8) Show annual Pro at $999/yr with a monthly/annual toggle.
(9) Change enterprise-call.ts to ENTERPRISE_BOOKING_URL with a Cal.com embed. Keep it null (fallback card) until T-072 has the event.
Run npm test and the voice probe, push, and log each item here.
decisions.why: approved-vendor-stack rules out Calendly; tantra-plan-lineup has no add-ons; enterprise-voice-rule sets 'Start free trial'; owner 2026-09-30 set 1 year. No session has a name for the $199 plan, so the placeholder stays. orchestrator-autonomy means I make these calls.
